# McDonald's Wrapped

A McDonald's China MCP toolbox and year in review generator. It can probe all 35 tools of the McDonald's China MCP and write an inventory of what each one returns (the seven write tools are never called, only listed with their schemas), build a public panorama report from public data only (campaign calendar, lottery information, points products, claimable coupons, nutrition), compute the expected value of the points lottery by local simulation under a stated equal probability assumption, and build your personal annual report from your own account: account summary, order history, mall orders, coupons and prizes, rendered as local HTML reports you can share. An optional dialect voice reading uses a local VoxCPM2 service or macOS voices. A demo mode with sample data works with no token at all.
